entries.name: FINCEN_8300_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder holding the store's Form 8300 filings log as CSV, one row per filing. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
Start the log from the template in docs/integrations/fincen_8300.md, as a spreadsheet saved as CSV.
After each filing in BSA E-Filing, add a row with the filing date, the sales, the cash, the date it was received and the BSA Tracking ID, then add the BSA ID and status once FinCEN acknowledges it.
Never put names, addresses or taxpayer numbers in the log.

entries.name: FINCEN_8300_DATE_ORDER
entries.description: How the log writes dates: mdy (10/30/2026), dmy (30/10/2026) or ymd (2026-10-30).
howToGet: Leave unset for US dates, month first.
